Собери дашборд админки. Слева — постоянная боковая навигация с разделами
(Главная, Пользователи, Заказы, Настройки) и возможностью сворачиваться в иконки.
В центре — большая таблица заказов: строки можно выделять, колонки можно
перетаскивать местами, плюс группировка строк по статусу заказа.

---
name: sandbox-headless-chromium-setup
description: How to get a working headless Chromium (Playwright) in this sandbox without root — needed for visual verification of UI work
metadata:
  type: project
---

The sandbox (Debian 12 arm64, user `node`, no sudo, no curl/python3, network available) has no browser and no fonts.
Working recipe (verified 2026-11-05):

1. `mkdir /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y && npm i playwright@1 && npx playwright install chromium`
2. Chromium lacks ~16 shared libs. Download them without root:
   `apt-get -o Dir::State=/tmp/apt/state -o Dir::Cache=/tmp/apt/cache -o Dir::State::status=/var/lib/dpkg/status -o Debug::NoLocking=1 update`
   then `apt-get ... download libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libgbm1 libdrm2 libexpat1 libwayland-server0 libatk1.0-0 libatspi2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libxi6 libffi8 libmount1 libpcre2-8-0 libselinux1 libsqlite3-0 libblkid1 fonts-dejavu-core`
   and `dpkg -x each.deb /tmp/apt/root`.
3. Fonts: without them text renders with zero width (locators report "not visible", innerText empty). Write a `fonts.conf` with `<dir>/tmp/apt/root/usr/share/fonts</dir>` and `<cachedir>/tmp/apt/fontcache</cachedir>`.
4. Run with `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/apt/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/apt/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/apt/fonts.conf node check.mjs`.
